info.title: Miami-Dade School Navigator API
info.description:
Map-based school navigator for Miami-Dade County (infancy to 12th grade). Every metric is a `Field` with status, source, url, as_of and method; missing data is returned as `not_available` with a reason and a next step. Data: Miami-Dade County GIS, FLDOE, curated rules (see /api/meta/quality).

**Language.** Send `X-Lang: en | es | ht` on any request (or `?lang=`, which wins over the header) and the API writes its own text (notes, `why` / `suggested_action` explanations, score reasons, questions to ask, compare labels, errors) in English, Spanish or Haitian Creole. Missing or unknown values mean English. `POST /api/plan` and `POST /api/chat` also take a `lang` body field, which wins for that request. `Field.method` is translated, but `verification: <level>` and the `Check:` marker inside it stay literal. `source`, `url`, school and place names, addresses and data values are never translated. The Spanish and Haitian Creole texts are AI-written and have not been reviewed by a native speaker; English is authoritative.

token.title: Token
token.description: Opaque session token: send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Unix time when the session ends.

ChatProfile.title: ChatProfile
ChatProfile.description: What the family has already told us. Held for the request only; nothing is stored.

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: Language of the answer. Omit to use the X-Lang header (English when absent). Translations are AI-written and not yet reviewed by a native speaker.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Model calls and tokens used by this turn (for quota monitoring).

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when the AI model was unavailable and only structured results are returned.

entering.title: Entering
entering.description: What the child is doing in the planning year, e.g. 'Kindergarten', 'VPK (Pre-K 4)', 'Grade 2', 'Past 12th grade'.

best_index.title: Best Index
best_index.description: Only set for numeric official fields where more is better.

exact.title: Exact
exact.description: False when computed from age only; the September 1 cut-off then makes it an estimate.

year.title: Year
year.description: School year the child first qualifies, for result=later.

source.title: Source
source.description: Dataset or rule the value comes from (for not_available: where we looked).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date the underlying data is current to (or was retrieved).

method.title: Method
method.description: How the value was obtained or computed.

why.title: Why
why.description: not_available only: why the value is missing.

suggested_action.title: Suggested Action
suggested_action.description: not_available only: what the family can do next.

Field.title: Field
Field.description: One value plus where it came from.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: 0-1. Address-point matches are high; a ZIP centroid is deliberately low.

schools_nearby.title: Schools Nearby
schools_nearby.description: Private schools within 5 miles whose FLDOE directory entry lists this program.

days_until.title: Days Until
days_until.description: Negative once the date has passed.

age.title: Age
age.description: Age today. Ignored when birth_date is given.

birth_date.title: Birth Date
birth_date.description: Optional. Exact eligibility depends on the September 1 cut-off, so a birth date gives exact answers; without it everything is estimated from age and labelled so.

field.description: Provenance of the main claim in `detail` (curated rule with its verification level, or an official/derived data field).

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: Language of the generated text. Omit to use the X-Lang header (English when absent). Translations are AI-written and not yet reviewed by a native speaker; English is authoritative.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: online_school: a virtual school with no campus to visit (its distance is only the office address). grade_match_unverified: the state grade was joined on a school number whose official names differ; confirm it is the same school.

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: How many candidates each hard filter removed.

data_available.title: Data Available
data_available.description: Which optional datasets are loaded, e.g. state_grades, learning_gains, scholarship_flags, magnet_themes, ese_signals; lets a client disable a filter that cannot match.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name, shown in the header after sign-in.

place_id.title: Place Id
place_id.description: Matching id in /api/schools, when the school is in the database.

features.title: Features
features.description: Each feature: a (Multi)Polygon plus properties level, school_name, school_source_id, place_id, source, url, as_of, method.

ZoneShapes.title: ZoneShapes
ZoneShapes.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of the attendance zones that contain a location, for drawing on a map.
